# Preprocessor Introduction

#### Course: Learn C Programming

## Preprocessor Introduction

So far, we have been using this code in all of our examples.

```c
#include <stdio.h>
```

Here, #include is a preprocessor directive that includes the stdio.h header file in our program.

As the name suggests, a preprocessor is used to transform (preprocess) our program before it

is compiled.

![Flowchart of running a C Program](data:image/png;base64,)

In C, there are different types of preprocessor and all begin with the # symbol.
